scenes.description: مجلس نجدي أنيق في ضوء العصر الذهبي، وشاب بثوب أبيض وغترة يمشي من الخلف ويطلع من الإطار ناحية الباب، وتبقى الكاميرا ثابتة على كرسيه الفاضي.

shot.lighting: Hard 3200K golden-hour key through a tall window camera-left casting long diagonal shadows across the carpet, warm bounce fill from sand-colored walls, faint dust motes lit in the beams
shot.composition: Vertical 9:16 frame with the empty armchair centered in the lower-middle third and tall window light and wall in the upper half. The man exits at frame-right toward the door, seen from behind, and leaves clear negative space in the frame. The door sits at frame-right, which is the screen direction for the whole ad.
shot.subject_action: A young man in a white thobe and ghutra walks away from camera and exits frame-right through the doorway, leaving the empty armchair.
shot.setting: Refined traditional Najdi majlis with floor cushions, a carved wooden side table, woven sadu textures and a sand-toned patterned carpet
shot.color_notes: Warm sand, deep brown wood, creamy white thobe, amber highlights

scenes.description: بعد ما راح، الغترة المعلّقة على المشجب تتأرجح بهدوء، وبخار القهوة يتصاعد من الدلة والفنجان كأن أحد بيشرب، وطرف القارورة يلمع على الطاولة الجانبية في الخلفية.

shot.lens: 50mm f/2, shallow depth of field, focus on the swaying ghutra with the background softly blurred
shot.lighting: Low warm 3000K window light from camera-left raking across fabric texture, soft amber rim on the steam, deep brown shadows on the right, no visible artificial sources
shot.composition: Tall frame with the ghutra hanging from a wooden peg in the upper-center. The dallah and cup sit at lower-left with rising steam. On the side table in the soft-focus background at frame-right, the unmarked glass perfume bottle is partially visible, catching a glint of gold light as a tease.
shot.subject_action: The hanging ghutra sways gently toward frame-right as if brushed by someone passing, while steam rises from the dallah and cup.
shot.setting: Corner of the majlis with a wooden wall peg, a brass dallah and small cup on a low tray, and a carved side table with the bottle partly in view
shot.color_notes: Warm sand and brown palette, soft golden glints on brass and glass

scenes.description: ستارة خفيفة تميل ناحية الباب اللي طلع منه، والضوء الذهبي يمشي معها على السجاد، والدخان الخفيف يتحرك بنفس الاتجاه كأنه أثره.

shot.lighting: Golden 3200K sunlight streaming through the sheer curtain from camera-left, soft diffusion and long moving shadows, warm bounce from the carpet, subtle cool 5600K spill from the open doorway at frame-right
shot.composition: Vertical frame with the sheer curtain filling the left-center and leaning toward the doorway at frame-right. The patch of golden light on the carpet leads the eye to the door in the lower right. The bottle is a small, soft-focus silhouette on the side table in the far background, left of center.
shot.subject_action: The sheer curtain leans slowly toward the doorway at frame-right as a light wisp of incense smoke drifts in the same direction.
shot.setting: Majlis window and doorway area with a sheer curtain, patterned carpet and a faint trail of oud smoke
shot.color_notes: Honey gold light against deep brown shadows, sand-colored curtain glow

scenes.description: لقطة قريبة للقارورة الفاخرة على الطاولة، والستارة تمر بظلها فوقها بلطف ثم تسكن، وتبقى القارورة هي الثابتة الوحيدة في المكان.

shot.lens: 100mm macro f/2.8, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the bottle's glass edges and cap
shot.lighting: Soft 3200K golden key from camera-left grazing the faceted glass, crisp warm highlights along the edges, dark brown rim and background falloff, a gentle curtain shadow passing over the surface
shot.composition: Vertical frame with the unmarked luxury glass bottle centered in the upper-middle two-thirds, a polished wooden tabletop and soft dark background around it. The lower fifth stays clear and empty for the tagline and end card. The bottle has no readable text or logo.
shot.subject_action: The soft shadow of the curtain drifts across the stationary bottle as the camera pushes in slowly.
shot.setting: Carved wooden side table in the majlis with a faintly blurred warm interior behind it
shot.color_notes: Amber glass glow, deep brown wood, sand-gold bokeh
